newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Sri Lankan army encircling Tamil rebel base.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lankan army encircling Tamil rebel base.

text.p: Sri Lankan security forces have almost surrounded the northern Tamil Tigers' stronghold of Kilinochchi in a pincer move, military officials said on Sunday.
"We're on the verge of encircling Kilinochchi," a military official said.

Troops, backed by tanks, artillery and air support, advancing on the western flank of the pincer move, were well to the south of the town and were moving to cut the main road leading from it, the military official said.

On the eastern flank, troops were consolidating positions captured from the Liberation Tigers of Tamil Eelam rebels during the week-long offensive in which well over 800 soldiers and rebels were killed, he said.

A third column of troops on Saturday began advancing from Paranthan, the launch pad of the offensive, on the main road which runs through Kilinochchi and met heavy rebel resistance after about one kilometre (about half a mile), he said.
Ground troops confirmed killing 35 rebels and wounding about 50 on Saturday while 10 soldiers were killed and 43, including an officer, were wounded, he added.
